title: Business Continuity Plan: WireRoom and LoanOrigination
body:
Business Continuity Plan: WireRoom and LoanOrigination
Author: Kevin Zhao, Software Engineer, Technology
Last updated: 2026-09-25
Status: Working draft for review by Operations, Lending, Compliance and Risk

Purpose and Scope
This plan describes how Halcyon Ridge Capital keeps wire transfer operations and loan origination running, or restores them quickly, during a technology outage or loss of staff or facilities. It covers WireRoom (the wire transfer operations console) and LoanOrigination (the loan origination system) and the upstream services they depend on. It does not replace the firm-wide plan owned by Linda Brandt, COO.

Dependency Map
WireRoom depends on PaymentsGateway. PaymentsGateway depends on GLCore and FraudScore, and FraudScore depends on DataLake. An outage in any of these affects wire release even when the WireRoom console itself is healthy.

LoanOrigination depends on ClientHub, CreditScoring and KYCPipeline. ClientHub depends on AuthSSO. KYCPipeline depends on ClientHub, DocVault and SanctionsScreen. CreditScoring depends on DataLake. An AuthSSO failure therefore blocks loan intake as well as wire entry.

Recovery Priorities
Tier 1 (restore first): AuthSSO, GLCore, PaymentsGateway, FraudScore, SanctionsScreen. Target recovery is 2 hours.
Tier 2: WireRoom, KYCPipeline, ClientHub, DocVault. Target recovery is 4 hours.
Tier 3: LoanOrigination, CreditScoring, DataLake. Target recovery is 8 hours.
Only Tier 1 and Tier 2 items are treated as same-day critical for the wire function. Loan closings can usually slip a business day without regulatory impact.

WireRoom Continuity Procedures
If WireRoom is unavailable but PaymentsGateway is healthy, Ravi Patel, Head of Operations, may authorize wire room specialists to submit instructions directly through the PaymentsGateway administrative interface. Every manually keyed wire requires dual approval by two wire room specialists and a callback verification where the client's standing instructions require it.

If FraudScore is degraded, wires are not released on a bypass. Marcus Bell, Chief Compliance Officer, or his delegate decides whether to hold all outbound wires or to allow low-value releases after manual screening by the AML team led by Nadia Petrov. Sanctions screening through SanctionsScreen is never skipped.

If GLCore is unavailable, wires are queued and not released, because posting must be possible. Operations logs queued items in the shared outage tracker and reconciles them against GLCore once it is restored. The #recon channel is used to flag any breaks that follow.

LoanOrigination Continuity Procedures
If LoanOrigination is down, Brian Kowalski, Head of Lending, activates the offline pipeline. Loan officers record new applications on the approved intake template stored in DocVault. Senior underwriters Joshua Gordon and Tammy Murphy continue credit review using the last exported pipeline report and CreditScoring outputs. Loan closers, led by Brandon George, hold all funding until the system is restored and the file has been reconciled.

If KYCPipeline is degraded, no loan may be funded without a completed KYC and CDD decision. Compliance KYC specialists may complete reviews manually and record outcomes in the #kyc-pipeline channel until the pipeline returns.

Ownership Change Note
Ownership of KYCPipeline moves from Operations to Compliance on 2026-10-06. Until that date, Operations is the escalation contact for KYCPipeline incidents. After that date, Compliance is the escalation contact, and this plan, the on-call rota and the contact sheet will be updated to reflect it. Jenna Cho, Compliance Engineering Lead, is the technical point of contact for the transition.

Staffing and Knowledge Risk
Priya Raman, Staff Engineer, leaves the firm on 2026-10-09. Her runbooks for the AuthSSO failover and DataLake restore must be reviewed and handed to Leo Martinez and Vincent Green before that date. Sam Okafor, Director of Engineering, owns that handoff. Omar Brown and Barbara Beard, Site Reliability Engineers, are the primary on-call contacts for infrastructure recovery.

Communication
Declare incidents in #incidents with the affected systems and a severity. Operations and Lending leads post updates at least every 60 minutes during a Tier 1 event. Wealth Management and Trading are notified through their channel leads if client payments are delayed. Catherine Hale, CEO, is informed of any outage lasting longer than 4 hours or involving a regulatory reporting obligation.

Testing and Review
Technology, Operations and Lending run a tabletop exercise each quarter covering a combined AuthSSO and PaymentsGateway outage. Failover of the offline loan intake process is tested twice a year. Findings go to Owen Gallagher, Head of Risk, and this plan is revised after each test and after any Tier 1 incident.
